gaps.t: GL has spend, Rent Manager has nothing
gaps.d: Accounting booked it, ops cannot see it. Anyone reading Rent Manager sees these units as free.
gaps.own: Controller seat, with John Clark confirming the work is real

gaps.t: No WIP or GL code on the issue
gaps.d: An invoice arriving for one of these has nowhere clean to land. None carries spend yet, so nothing has gone astray so far. Cheapest fix on the program and it has a natural deadline.
gaps.own: John Clark supplies the units, Accounting assigns the codes

gaps.t: Vendor tracker far above GL booked
gaps.d: Either High Pace has done work it has not billed, which is an accrual we are missing, or the tracker is priced above what will be billed, which means the forecast is too high. Opposite problems, one flag. One question to Mark Doucette settles all nine.
gaps.own: Austin — he is on the Wednesday call

gaps.t: On the board, not in the vendor tracker
gaps.d: All 22 Origins units and all 16 Kippy units are in here. The Wednesday call reads from that tracker, so it has never seen either fund.
gaps.own: unassigned — both funds are Jon Wyss's side of the house

gaps.d: If these were placed in service the money is capitalised and WIP is clean. If not, roughly a million dollars sits in work-in-progress for finished homes. The export carries a GL actual, not a GL account, so no source here can say which.
Ten of these are Silver Breeze units that all started 2026-04-17 — one batch that never got worked, not ten slow rehabs. SOUTH-86 and BRUN-203 are the last two of John Clark's Q1 rock.
A start date is how a rehab enters the 60-day clock. These are not on it. 26 other rows carry a future start and 6 carry dates that do not parse, so the field is not being maintained.

gaps.t: Open with no vendor at all
gaps.d: Work on the board that nobody is doing. Fourteen of the fifteen are also in the 37-row uncoded cohort.
gaps.own: unassigned — assign at the Wednesday call

gaps.t: The 37-row cohort — a second intake path never onboarded
gaps.d: Every row missing from the vendor tracker, and every row missing a WIP code, is in this cohort. The other 182 rows have zero of these defects. 16 internal Parakeet Ops jobs and 16 unassigned units, keyed by unit code instead of community, untiered, uncoded.
